quarterly_data.signal: NetApp reported fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 (ended April 24, 2026) net revenues of $1.95 billion, up 12% year-over-year, and fiscal 2026 net revenues of $6.93 billion, up 5%; all-flash array net revenue was a record $1.2 billion in Q4, up 18% year-over-year, and Public Cloud net revenue a record $182 million, up 11%.
quarterly_data.figure: Q4 FY2026 net revenues $1.95 billion (+12% YoY); FY2026 $6.93 billion (+5%); Q4 all-flash array $1.2 billion (+18% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: NetApp guided first-quarter fiscal 2027 net revenues of $1.750 billion - $1.900 billion (non-GAAP EPS $2.05 - $2.15) and full fiscal 2027 net revenues of $7.325 billion - $7.575 billion (non-GAAP EPS $8.70 - $9.00).
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 FY2027 net revenues $1.750 billion - $1.900 billion; FY2027 $7.325 billion - $7.575 billion

quarterly_data.signal: In Q4 fiscal 2026 NetApp launched the AI Data Engine, an end-to-end AI data platform co-engineered with NVIDIA, and announced next-generation EF50 and EF80 high-performance storage systems for workloads like AI, HPC and databases; it also announced an expanded, multi-year collaboration with Google Cloud for Google Distributed Cloud environments.
